spots.name: Craig
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 143 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1356382.

spots.name: Klawock

spots.name: Hiilaang Ts'uujuus Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 785 m (2,576 ft).

spots.name: Silver Salmon Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
